scope: Week 7 (Oct 13-17, 2026) recheck of the open kickoffs and networks left by the reviewed release: three official TBA kickoffs, two unpublished networks and two ABC-or-ESPN alternatives.
rule: A kickoff is adopted when a participating school's official schedule publishes it and ESPN lists the same instant. A network is adopted when a participating school publishes it and no reviewed source lists a different one. The other school still listing TBA/TBD is recorded, not treated as a conflict (the release's Ohio State-Indiana precedent). A conflicting time or network from any primary source blocks adoption.
renderer: Cloudflare Browser Rendering (markdown), school pages; ESPN site API summaries saved and hashed.

conference_pages.note: Conference football schedule pages did not render (404 or error page) on 2026-10-11 and were not used.
